resources.string: Add it once in your device\'s Settings, then switch languages from the keyboard with the globe key or by swiping the space bar.
Choose Languages & input (on Samsung: General management)
Pick the keyboard you use, such as Gboard or Samsung Keyboard
Languages → Add keyboard → 한국어, then choose 2-Set (Dubeolsik) or 10-key (Cheonjiin)
How to add a Korean keyboard
No Korean keyboard was detected. If Korean doesn\'t appear, check the setup guide after this session.
Switch your keyboard to Korean Dubeolsik with the globe key or by swiping the space bar.
Tap the field and switch your keyboard to Korean. Changes during composition are not counted as mistakes.
